# KanbanBoardElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasKanbanBoardElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasKanbanBoard.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasKanbanBoard.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasKanbanBoard.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A Kanban board, and the cumulative flow diagram over its history

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasKanbanBoard](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasKanbanBoard.md)
- [UltraCanvasElementPlugins](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasElementPlugins.md)
- [UltraCanvasSmoothScroll](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSmoothScroll.md)
- [UltraCanvasKanbanBoardProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasKanbanBoardProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasKanbanBoardElement> CreateKanbanBoardElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasKanbanBoardElement> CreateKanbanBoardWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<KanbanDataSource> data, KanbanDesign design = KanbanDesign::Professional, const std::string& title = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasKanbanBoardElement> CreateKanbanBoardFromText( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const std::string& textDefinition, KanbanDesign design = KanbanDesign::Professional, std::string* error = nullptr);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasKanbanBoardElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCardMoved` | `std::function<void(int cardId, int fromColumnId, int toColumnId)> onCardMoved` | _Card moved_ |
| `onCardAdded` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onCardAdded` | Via the editor UI |
| `onCardRemoved` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onCardRemoved` | Via the editor UI |
| `onCardClick` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onCardClick` | _Card click_ |
| `onCardDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onCardDoubleClick` | Editor consumed it |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onSelectionChanged` | when editable -1 = cleared |
| `onWipExceeded` | `std::function<void(int columnId)> onWipExceeded` | _Wip exceeded_ |
| `onBoardChanged` | `std::function<void()> onBoardChanged` | Any editor mutation |
| `onContextMenu` | `std::function<void(int cardId, int columnId, const Point2Di& windowPos)> onContextMenu` | A right click: the card under it (-1 = none; the card is selected first), the column (-1 = none) and the point in window coordinates, where a popup menu opens. |
| `onCardHoverChanged` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onCardHoverChanged` | The card under the pointer changed (-1 = none any more, also when a drag starts or the pointer leaves the board). |
| `onCardPointerMoved` | `std::function<void(int cardId)> onCardPointerMoved` | The pointer moved over a card (not while dragging one): called on every move, the card's first one included, so a host that restarts a short timer here opens something when the pointer comes to rest. |
| `onDeleteKey` | `std::function<bool(int cardId)> onDeleteKey` | The Delete key on the selected card of an editable board. Set, it decides: true = handled (the board removes nothing itself - the application asks first, say, or deletes what the card stands for); false = the board removes the card as when unset. |
| `canDropCard` | `std::function<bool(int cardId, int toColumnId)> canDropCard` | Editable boards can veto a drop (e.g. strict WIP enforcement). |
| `onFilesDropped` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>& files, int columnId, int laneId)> onFilesDropped` | Files dropped onto the board from outside (a file manager, the desktop): the column under the drop point and its lane (-1 = none or no lanes). While set, a file drag over the board highlights the column it would land in; unset, drops pass on to the parents. |
| `cardImageProvider` | `std::function<std::shared_ptr<UCPixmap>(const KanbanCard& card)> cardImageProvider` | A picture for a card - a file's thumbnail - drawn above its title, fitted into a band style.cardImageHeight high. Called while the board lays out and draws, on the UI thread, so it must answer at once: hand over what is ready, or nullptr (no picture, or not yet; InvalidateLayout() when it arrives). Not used by Pill or … |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
